output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in totalSupply and balanceOf[target] is not bounded by the uint256 type, allowing the _value parameter to be manipulated to overflow and set the balance of an arbitrary user to a pre-determined target value.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing the _value parameter to be manipulated to overflow and set the balance of an arbitrary user to a pre-determined target value.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing the _value parameter to be manipulated to overflow and set the balance of an arbitrary user to a pre-determined target value.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_from] >= _value, allowing the _value parameter to be manipulated to overflow and set the balance of an arbitrary user to a pre-determined target value.
The setPrices function is typographically similar to a constructor, allowing anyone to set the buyPrice and sellPrice, leading to incorrect initial buy and sell price.
